#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t)
where MSD is in Angstrom^2 and t is in picoseconds (metal units)
Result is converted to m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # ps

# Remove the first point (t=0, MSD=0)
time = time[1:]
msd = msd[1:]

# Fit linear region to get slope
# Use the last 80% of data for fitting (more equilibrated)
fit_start = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[fit_start:]
msd_fit = msd[fit_start:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-20 / 1e-12
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8

D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"MSD slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (formatted): {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"MSD slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.2f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300)
print("MSD plot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Calculate and print the final answer in the required format
answer = D_m2_s * 1e9  # Convert to 10^-9 m^2/s for easier reading
print(f"\nFinal answer (in units of 10^-9 m^2/s): {answer:.2f}")
print(f"Final answer (in m^2/s): {D_m2_s:.2e}")

data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time = (steps - steps[0]) * 0.001  # in ps

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using linear fit
# D = slope / 6, where slope is from MSD vs time
# Use the linear region (skip initial transient)

# Skip first 20% of data to avoid initial transient
skip = int(len(time) * 0.2)
time_fit = time[skip:]
msd_fit = msd[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Ų/ps

# Diffusion coefficient in Ų/ps
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Ų/ps = 1e-20 m² / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (scientific): {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s")

# Calculate R² to check fit quality
msd_pred = np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit)
ss_res = np.sum((msd_fit - msd_pred)**2)
ss_tot = np.sum((msd_fit - np.mean(msd_fit))**2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"R² of linear fit: {r_squared:.6f}")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, msd_pred, 'r--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_squared:.4f})')

plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')

plt.grid(True)

    f.write(f"=" * 60 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"R² of linear fit: {r_squared:.6f}\n")

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt (slope = 6D)
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # This is 6D in Å²/ps
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # D in Å²/ps

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = 1e-20 m² / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient calculation:")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"================================================\n\n")
    f.write(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer (m²/s): {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.2f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot_with_fit.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved as 'msd_plot.png' and 'msd_plot_with_fit.png'")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (eV, Angstrom, ps, K, bar)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       Si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration at 300K
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2500 - 300 = 2200 K
# Time needed: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps (NPT)
# ============================================
# Reset MSD compute before production run
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration at 2500K
unfix           3

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the equilibration data
data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract Step and MSD columns
steps = data['Step'].values
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Convert steps to time (ps) - timestep is 0.001 ps = 1 fs
# But steps are absolute, so we need to calculate time from the start of this run
time = (steps - steps[0]) * 0.001  # in ps

# Print data info
print(f"Number of data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd[0]:.6f} to {msd[-1]:.6f} Angstrom^2")

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll use linear regression on the linear part of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 20% of data)
skip = int(0.2 * len(time))
time_fit = time[skip:]
msd_fit = msd[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D in Angstrom^2/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [A^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12) = D [A^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s")

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nCalculation details:\n")
    f.write(f"Number of data points: {len(time)}\n")
    f.write(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Data points used for fit: {len(time_fit)} (skipped first {skip})\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

# Format for submission (numerical value without units)
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER FOR SUBMISSION:")
print(f"{D_m2_s:.2e}")
print(f"{'='*50}")
